metadata.question: In 2003, using MODIS Land Surface Temperature (LST) data, did Queensland, Australia record a higher maximum daytime land surface temperature compared to Lut Desert, Iran and El Azizia, Libya?

data.raw_code: 1. Search strategy: - Use MODIS Terra LST (MOD11A1) or MOD11A2 for 2003 - Three locations: Queensland (Australia), Lut Desert (Iran), El Azizia (Libya) - Need daytime LST (LST_Day_1km band) - Compare maximum temperatures across all three regions 2. Masking strategy: - Use QC bands to mask poor quality pixels - MODIS LST has QC_Day band for quality control - Need to ensure valid measurements 3. Logic: - Get max LST for each region in 2003 - Compare: Queensland_max > Lut_max AND Queensland_max > ElAzizia_max - Valid Zero: LST values should be in Kelvin (reasonable range 250-350K or so) - C3 if any result is None/NaN or outside reasonable range - C2 if no valid pixels after masking - C1 if no images found ```javascript const ee = require('@google/earthengine'); const privateKey = require('../auth_keys/test-project-473922-29f05d49bed7'); async function runAnalysis() { // 1. Define geometries for the three locations const queensland = ee.Geometry.Rectangle([138, -29, 153, -10]); // Queensland region const lutDesert = ee.Geometry.Point([58.5, 30.8]); // Lut Desert, Iran const elAzizia = ee.Geometry.Point([13.03, 32.53]); // El Azizia, Libya // 2. Load MODIS LST data for 2003 const startDate = '2003-01-01'; const endDate = '2003-12-31'; // Function to mask based on QC function maskLST(image) { const qc = image.select('QC_Day'); const mask = qc.bitwiseAnd(3).lte(1); // Keep good quality (00 or 01) return image.select('LST_Day_1km').updateMask(mask).multiply(0.02); // Scale factor } // Load collection let collection = ee.ImageCollection('MODIS/006/MOD11A1') .filterDate(startDate, endDate) .map(maskLST); const collectionSize = collection.size().getInfo(); console.log(`Total images in collection: ${collectionSize}`); if (collectionSize === 0) { console.log("No MODIS data found for 2003."); console.log("C1"); return; } // 3. Calculate maximum LST for each region // Queensland const qldCol = collection.filterBounds(queensland); const qldSize = qldCol.size().getInfo(); console.log(`Queensland images: ${qldSize}`); if (qldSize === 0) { console.log("No data for Queensland."); console.log("C1"); return; } const qldMax = qldCol.max().reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.max(), geometry: queensland, scale: 3000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).get('LST_Day_1km'); const qldCount = qldCol.max().reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.count(), geometry: queensland, scale: 3000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).get('LST_Day_1km'); const qldMaxVal = qldMax.getInfo(); const qldCountVal = qldCount.getInfo(); console.log(`Queensland: Max=${qldMaxVal}K, Pixels=${qldCountVal}`); // Lut Desert const lutCol = collection.filterBounds(lutDesert); const lutSize = lutCol.size().getInfo(); console.log(`Lut Desert images: ${lutSize}`); if (lutSize === 0) { console.log("No data for Lut Desert."); console.log("C1"); return; } const lutMax = lutCol.max().reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.max(), geometry: lutDesert.buffer(5000), scale: 3000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).get('LST_Day_1km'); const lutMaxVal = lutMax.getInfo(); console.log(`Lut Desert: Max=${lutMaxVal}K`); // El Azizia const aziziaCol = collection.filterBounds(elAzizia); const aziziaSize = aziziaCol.size().getInfo(); console.log(`El Azizia images: ${aziziaSize}`); if (aziziaSize === 0) { console.log("No data for El Azizia."); console.log("C1"); return; } const aziziaMax = aziziaCol.max().reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.max(), geometry: elAzizia.buffer(5000), scale: 3000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).get('LST_Day_1km'); const aziziaMaxVal = aziziaMax.getInfo(); console.log(`El Azizia: Max=${aziziaMaxVal}K`); // 4. Validation and comparison if (qldCountVal === 0) { console.log("No valid pixels for Queensland after masking."); console.log("C2"); return; } if (qldMaxVal === null || lutMaxVal === null || aziziaMaxVal === null) { console.log("Calculation failed - null result."); console.log("C3"); return; } if (qldMaxVal < 250 || qldMaxVal > 360 || lutMaxVal < 250 || lutMaxVal > 360 || aziziaMaxVal < 250 || aziziaMaxVal > 360) { console.log("Invalid temperature range detected."); console.log("C3"); return; } // 5. Final comparison console.log(`\nComparison: QLD(${qldMaxVal.toFixed(2)}K) vs Lut(${lutMaxVal.toFixed(2)}K) vs Azizia(${aziziaMaxVal.toFixed(2)}K)`); if (qldMaxVal > lutMaxVal && qldMaxVal > aziziaMaxVal) { console.log("A"); } else { console.log("B"); } } async function initEE() { await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.data.authenticateViaPrivateKey(privateKey, resolve, reject); }); await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.initialize(null, null, resolve, reject); }); await runAnalysis(); } initEE(); ```
